Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, then to activities on record_id, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for human B-raf kinase and target_dictionary.organism for human. Filter activities.standard_type for IC50. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
